item.text:
For the `mistral-small-latest` model used in Mistral’s Document QnA example, the context limit was 128k tokens (Mistral Small 3.2). The current `mistral-small-latest` points to Small 4, whose limit is 256k. In either case, 321,774 prompt tokens exceed the limit. [Small 3.2 model card](https://docs.mistral.ai/models/mistral-small-3-2-25-06), [current context limits](https://docs.mistral.ai/resources/known-limitations)

The PDF is expensive because you sent the binary as an inline Base64 data URI. A 308 kB file expands by roughly 33% to about 411 kB of Base64 text, and Base64 is tokenized as ordinary input text rather than as a compact PDF reference. That produces roughly 322k prompt tokens before the question or system prompt. Document QnA then uses OCR followed by model analysis; the token count reflects the huge inline payload, not the amount of human-readable text on the page. [Document QnA](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/document-processing/document_qna), [OCR with Base64 PDFs](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/document-processing/basic_ocr)

Use an uploaded PDF or a publicly accessible `document_url` instead of embedding the Base64 string directly.
